result:
The dependency upgrades are done and both audits are clean, but three acceptance checks are not fully met: `pnpm test` under C.UTF-8 exits 1, integration exits 1, and the full e2e did not complete. The changes are uncommitted for you to integrate. The handback is `docs/delivery/handbacks/DG6/T-DG6-DO-A2-devops-engineer.md`, with logs in `T-DG6-DO-A2-evidence/`. I ran from 03:22 to 05:16 UTC, about 114 minutes. `validate --historical --stage DG5` exited 0 at the start and the end.

**Audit result:** no High or Critical advisory remains on shipped packages.
- Live `pnpm audit --audit-level high --prod` exits 0: 4 low and 6 moderate remain, in ajv, uuid and fast-uri. They are listed in the handback.
- The offline `dep-audit.mjs` check exits 0.
- The SBOM (483 packages, every shipped one with a licence id) and the advisory snapshot are regenerated.

**Versions:**
- fastify 5.12.7, @fastify/static 10.1.7, kysely 0.28.18, zod 4.6.7, react-router 7.18.4, vitest 3.2.7, vite 7.3.7.
- image-size 2.0.4 and tinypool 2.2.0 are forced through pnpm overrides, because no fixed 1.x version of either exists.
- pptxgenjs never actually calls image-size; its only use is in commented-out code. The new test embeds a PNG and a JPEG and checks the PPTX, and it passes along with the 5 existing PPTX tests.
- `@aws-sdk/client-s3@3.1156.0` is pinned in apps/api and `nodemailer@10.2.1` in apps/api and apps/worker. nodemailer ships its own types, so no `@types/nodemailer` is needed.
- GitHub release pages were blocked (403). For fastify, zod, kysely, vitest, tinypool and @fastify/static I checked breaking changes by diffing the published packages instead.

**Code changes the upgrades forced:**
- **zod string length:** zod 4.6 counts string length in characters (code points) rather than UTF-16 units. This produced a double error on short invisible text, breaking the "one error, never two" rule. I changed the shared text rule to count the same way and adjusted its test.
- **zod `z.unknown()` keys:** a field declared `z.unknown()` is now required. That broke the search when `q` is missing. I added `.optional()` to the six such fields, which restores the DG5 behaviour. One web type was loosened to match, and a new test pins both zod changes.
- **fastify:** `requestIdLogLabel` is deprecated; it is now passed through `LogController`. The log label is still `requestId`.
- **@fastify/static 10** needed no change.

**Checks:**

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| typecheck, build, lint, prettier, `openapi:lint` | all exit 0 (922 operations) |
| `pnpm test`, locale unset | exit 0: unit-node 2464, unit-web 1768, formula 259 + 2 old skips |
| `pnpm test`, C.UTF-8 | every test passes, but **exit 1**: Vitest reported 2 unhandled worker timeouts (`onTaskUpdate`) |
| Integration | **exit 1**: 3301 passed, 8 failed (all explained below) |
| e2e demo suite | 12/12 |
| e2e C.UTF-8 subset | 76/76 |
| Full e2e | **not complete** |

- **C.UTF-8 timeouts:** they happened while the host load was 13–20, with integration and two e2e runs going at the same time. An earlier run on the same versions exited 0 in both locales, which points to load. I haven't proved that; if it recurs on a quiet host, the vitest 3 + tinypool 2 override is the suspect.
- **Integration failures:**
  - 4 were the zod `z.unknown()` problem; they pass after the fix when re-run alone.
  - 2 were load timeouts or totals that depend on another test.
  - 1 was a search test caused by the same zod problem.
  - 1 already fails on the base commit: the integrity-sweep test expects only `retireDependencyType` as a DELETE operation, but the W4 contract also has `deleteSavedView`. I changed neither file, so it needs an owner.
- **Full e2e:** I broke my own locale-unset run by rebuilding `apps/web/dist` while its server was serving it. The static plugin only routes the files present at start-up, so every page after that failed to load. Tests 1–197 had all passed before the rebuild. Two specs that "failed" afterwards pass 20/20 on a fresh server. The rest of that run doesn't count.

**Left for you:**
- Re-run `LANG=C.UTF-8 LC_ALL=C.UTF-8 pnpm test` on a quiet host.
- Run the full e2e once per locale on the merged tree, without rebuilding during the run.
- Decide who owns the `deleteSavedView` sweep failure.
- Optionally bump the remaining moderate advisories; they don't block the gate.

Because npm's cache and the pnpm store are read-only in this sandbox, I installed with a private store under `$TMPDIR`. This worktree's next `pnpm install` will relink everything. The lockfile is unaffected.
